# Phase Three — Tiferes Execution Plan

The Awtsmoos joins broken runtime and crowded surface into one repairable story;
Awtsmoos.com will reveal Torah first, creation second, and advanced machinery only when intention asks for glory.

## Thirty final execution checks
1. Read post route template and `initial-content.html` completely.
2. Trace dynamic-template data variables from route entry to included content.
3. Reproduce the `$$sd` failure locally with the project server/template processor.
4. Identify whether the bug is source or deployment drift.
5. Rewrite the broken reader template file completely.
6. Split any touched oversized reader file before adding behavior.
7. Add a focused reader composition regression test.
8. Verify reader returns content rather than raw exception code.
9. Inspect reader mobile CSS and fixed controls.
10. Create a small reader mobile hierarchy layer only if real evidence requires it.
11. Read current Heichel mobile-first diff and contract.
12. Run its existing test before altering Heichel work.
13. Reproduce the tree screenshot geometry in Chrome.
14. Repair only remaining Heichel defects, respecting current work.
15. Inspect composer DOM ownership for sticky publish, commands, tools, and canvas.
16. Inspect composer CSS import order and mobile breakpoints.
17. Rewrite composer mobile layout into compact action/disclosure modules.
18. Ensure writing canvas has bottom clearance and no overlay coverage.
19. Ensure publish remains obvious and one-tap reachable.
20. Verify composer at 390px and 320px with editable text area visible.
21. Verify Social Hub current local simplified build remains green.
22. Confirm production deployment still needs explicit release action.
23. Inspect repository production deployment contract.
24. Build one mobile journey covering Home → Heichel → post reader → composer → Social Hub.
25. Assert zero raw error text and zero horizontal overflow.
26. Assert no large fixed panel overlaps content.
27. Assert advanced controls are closed by default where nonessential.
28. Run route/unit suites for every touched subsystem.
29. Commit only isolated release files and push safely against latest main.
30. Deploy using the real project release mechanism and verify live assets/content.

## Expected file families
- Reader route/template under `heichelos/post/` and a focused reader regression test.
- Heichel mobile files only if current dirty work still leaves screenshot defects.
- Composer mobile CSS/templates split into focused modules.
- Social Hub only if final integration evidence finds a regression.
- Production release scripts are read and invoked, not guessed or rewritten unless objectively broken.

Tiferes is the meeting point: Torah becomes readable, creation becomes possible, and the machine becomes quiet enough to serve both.
